thesis: Macroscopic regularities can emerge from dynamics, statistics and special historical conditions.
role: Explain entropy and temporal direction without reducing them to slogans.

ideas.statement: Macrostates group microstates, and frequent aggregate outcomes can reflect multiplicity rather than special commands to components.
The arrow of time depends on initial conditions as well as dynamics; identical equations need not yield identical macroscopic histories.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Coin combinatorics is not a thermodynamic proof; organisms exchange energy and matter, and microscopic possibility is not reasonable expectation.
